title: Clara's Information
description: Learn about the masked swordmaster from Clara

story: Clara: "Oh! You startled me! I've been hiding here since the bell started ringing."
"I know what's happening. There's a masked swordmaster who has been taking people."
"He has a secret lair somewhere, but I don't know where."
Eleanor: "A masked swordmaster? That sounds scary!"
Ask Clara more about the swordmaster.
commands: echo "Tell us more about the swordmaster"
hints: Use echo to ask Clara about the swordmaster.

story: Clara: "The swordmaster wears a mask and carries a powerful sword."
"I heard he might be hiding in the woods or maybe in a cave."
"The library's private section might have more information, but it's locked."
Eleanor: "We need to find a way to stop him and rescue everyone!"
Ask Clara if she wants to come with you.
hints: Use echo to ask Clara to join you.

story: Clara: "I'm too scared to leave this cellar. But I'll stay here and keep watch."
"Eleanor can stay with me if she wants to be safe."
Eleanor: "I want to help you find the swordmaster! I'll stay brave."
It's time to leave the restaurant and continue your quest.
hints: Use 'cd ../..' to go back to the east town area.
